title: LugiaSMP
description: A polished Cobblemon 1.21.1 modpack featuring optimized performance, enhanced world exploration, and full integration with the LugiaSMP multiplayer server.
body:
# 🌊 LugiaSMP: The Ultimate Cobblemon Adventure

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **PROJECT STATUS: This modpack is no longer being actively developed or maintained. You are free to use, modify, or repurpose it for your own projects!**
> 
> **USAGE NOTE:** If you plan to use this pack or its assets, please provide credit to the original **LugiaSMP** project and the artist **sinopurrino** for the custom logo and title screen art. 
> 
> **✨ Support the Artist:** The artwork for this project such as the logo and title screen/backgrounds was custom-made by **sinopurrino** on Discord or located on ToyHouse - [here](https://toyhou.se/SinoPurrino). She is available for commissions! If you want your own project to have a high-quality, professional look, I highly recommend reaching out to her for custom logos, titles, and illustrations.

LugiaSMP is a magical and cozy Cobblemon experience designed for explorers, builders, and battlers alike. This modpack provides a smooth, optimized, and beginner-friendly journey on **Minecraft 1.21.1**.

---

## 🗺️ A World Built for Exploration

This pack is designed to make the Minecraft world feel alive and rewarding for those who wander.

* **Custom Biomes:** Explore mystical forests, sparkling lakes, and glowing caves.
* **Hidden Secrets:** Discover rare Cobblemon tucked away in unique locations that reward the curious.
* **Immersive Environments:** Experience a world tailored for a living, breathing atmosphere.

## 🌿 Performance & Accessibility

Built with stability in mind, the LugiaSMP modpack ensures you spend more time playing and less time troubleshooting.

* **Optimized Performance:** Experience high FPS and smooth gameplay even in resource-heavy areas.
* **Beginner Friendly:** Perfectly tuned for both Cobblemon veterans and players catching their very first partner.
* **Streamlined Experience:** A polished, stable environment ready for an immediate start.

## 🏡 Build, Create, and Thrive

Your imagination is the only limit within this collection of mods.

* **Endless Building:** Design massive cities, cozy cottages, or secret underground bases with enhanced block palettes.
* **Survival Gathering:** Challenge yourself in survival to gather resources for your masterpieces.
* **Creative Freedom:** Use the included utility mods to make your building process more efficient.

---

### 📜 Technical Details

* **Version:** Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric)
* **Base Mod:** [Cobblemon](https://cobblemon.com/en)

---

### ⚖️ Disclaimer & Credits

*LugiaSMP is an independent project and is **not** affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the official Cobblemon Team. All trademarks, textures, and icons belong to their respective owners.*

> 🎨 **Artistic Credit:** All custom Logo and Title Screen art was expertly crafted by **sinopurrino** on Discord. 
> 
> 🛠️ **Technical Credit:** A special thanks to **fejivt** on Discord for the technical implementation of the title screen. While **sinopurrino** created the visual assets, **fejivt** handled the configuration and setup within the title screen mods to bring the vision to life.
